answer: Agent economies resist sybil by making each identity earn a reputation score through verified countersigned actions that compound over epochs. A new wallet entering through the onyx gate starts at zero and must pay a small entry bond, so mass clones are costly. Sudden oasis of anonymous actors triggers throttling until they pass peer review. Like an knoll with a single safe harbor, only identities with proven history can dock. Repetition of real work, not fresh addresses, is the moat.
